fit_rule: Minimize mean query NLL within each nonempty boundary, then mean boundaries within each episode, then mean all 64 episodes equally. Fit independently per checkpoint from all 64 prior C histories. Evaluate beta endpoints [0.05, 20], identity, and 64 fixed bisections if the optimum is interior, followed by the final midpoint: at most 68 objective and derivative passes. Exact ties or a candidate NLL worse than identity use beta=1. No probability floor: a zero probability on a true target fails fitting.
layout_identity: Use the same evaluator-only deck digest as before. Neither hidden ranks nor the digest reach the actor. Reconstruct all 64 layouts from the union of actual public frames in the saved-output audit. Retain duplicate layouts without replacement.
limits: The prior C evaluation set is now training input for this new study; its results cannot serve as this study's test.
No tuning on the new 64 test cases, adopting the hard control after observing a win, checkpoint selection, retraining, retries, or budget extensions.
The original architecture FAIL (1 of 6 criteria) and previous controller PASS remain unchanged.
Scalar temperature scaling is established prior art, not a novel memory architecture, RL algorithm, or calibrated Bayesian posterior.
There are 64 paired deck draws with 18 fixed fits. Repeated games and queries are not independent layouts.
Probability power scaling uses saved float32 softmax values cast to float64, not inaccessible pre-softmax logits. Disclose underflow separately; never silently smooth wrong hard beliefs.
A calibration pass qualifies a stronger control only. It does not establish superiority to last32, scenario transfer, or ICLR readiness.
order: Run delta, gated_delta, kalman, innovation_local, innovation_matched, gru, each with paired fits 0, 1, 2. Run cases 0 through 63 with their literal rotating belief order. Then run exact and last32, each baseline only. All 18 scalar fits must complete and be hash-bound before the first fresh model restore or reset.

policies.baseline: Same frozen C picker and original raw model probabilities; no temperature fitting affects this arm
policies.hard: Deterministic lowest-index argmax rank becomes one-hot, followed by identical C picker/overrides. This is a nonprobabilistic control; any wrong queried rank has infinite NLL
policies.temperature: Fitted positive inverse temperature beta on saved raw probabilities, p**beta normalized, then unchanged C normalization and public overrides; beta=1 exact value bypass

preset_visualization.selection: First literal evaluation case, chosen before scalar fitting or fresh native evaluation; show all three policies even if none succeeds.

proper_score_rule: On all 64 NEW baseline trajectories per fit, compare baseline, temperature, and hard on exactly the same raw outputs, public pre-action masks and labels, and hierarchical weights. This fixed-prefix comparison is separate from native utility on diverging transformed-policy histories. NLL reduction is (baseline-temperature)/baseline; a zero baseline makes the criterion undefined and failed. Brier sums the 13 squared class errors.
